must_show: the defect and where it is
how the use of the dwelling is affected
documents.title: Record of the defect (dated photographs, inspection or expert report)

must_show: how and when the landlord learned of the defect
documents.title: Proof of when the landlord learned of the defect (tenant's dated notice, landlord's or manager's acknowledgement, or inspection record)
Proof of the damage (invoices, receipts, photographs of damaged items)

must_show: announcement that rent will be deposited
documents.title: Tenant's written time limit to the landlord and written announcement of the deposit

must_show: due date of the first deposited rent
date the claims were brought before the conciliation authority (or that they have not yet been)
documents.title: Receipt of the deposit office for the deposited rent and the tenant's application to the conciliation authority

facts.question: Does the claim state that the rented dwelling has a defect (for example mould, damp, or heating that fails) or that the tenant is disturbed in using the dwelling as agreed, without the claim itself saying that the tenant alone caused the defect or must remedy it at his own expense?
Does the claim state that the landlord does not yet know of the defect (the tenant has not reported it and the landlord has not learned of it in another way)?
Does the claim state that the landlord learned of the defect only orally, so that no written notice, written acknowledgement or inspection record of it exists?
Does the tenant claim compensation from the landlord for damage the defect caused to the tenant (for example damaged furniture or clothing, or extra costs)?
Does the claim state that the tenant intends to pay the rent on deposit with the office designated by the canton instead of to the landlord, or has begun to do so?
Does the claim state that at least one rent payment has already been paid into deposit with the office designated by the canton?

types.title: Defect of the rented dwelling (mould, damp, heating)

must_show: agreed notice periods and termination dates
documents.title: Lease contract

must_show: whether the form approved by the canton is used
documents.title: Landlord's notice of termination

must_show: how it was delivered (registered-mail tracking, envelope or acknowledgement)
documents.title: Proof of the date the notice was received

must_show: addressed to the spouse or registered partner
served separately from the tenant's copy
where the notice followed a payment time limit (art. 257d): the separately served copy of that time limit
documents.title: Proof of separate service on the spouse or registered partner (the spouse's own copy with envelope or tracking), or the spouse's statement that no separate copy was received

must_show: time limit set and date it was received
warning that the lease will be terminated
payments made within the time limit (bank or postal records)
documents.title: Landlord's written payment time limit with warning of termination, and the tenant's record of payments made within it

must_show: claims the tenant asserted (for example a repair demand or a rent challenge), with dates
the reasons the landlord gave for the notice (on the notice, or given on request)
conciliation or court documents on those claims, if any
documents.title: Correspondence on the tenant's claims and the landlord's reasons for the notice
Evidence of the tenant's personal, family and financial circumstances

facts.question: Has the landlord given the tenant notice terminating the lease of the dwelling, and has it reached the tenant?
Does the claim state that the tenant is married or in a registered partnership and that the rented dwelling serves as the family home?
Does the notice or the claim state that the landlord terminated because the tenant did not pay overdue rent or accessory charges within a time limit the landlord had set?
Does the claim state that the landlord gave notice because the tenant had, in good faith, asserted claims under the lease (for example demanded repair of a defect or contested the rent)?
Does the tenant seek an extension of the lease because having to leave by the end date would be a hardship for the tenant or the tenant's family?

types.title: Termination of the lease by the landlord

must_show: date from which the increase applies
whether the form approved by the canton is used (for a graduated-rent step, whether it is in writing: art. 269d para. 5)
any threat of termination in it or in the covering letter
for an index-linked increase: the old and new index values
if the landlord gave no notice at all, that absence is itself the finding (art. 269d para. 2 let. a)
documents.title: Landlord's rent increase notice (with any covering letter)

must_show: how it was delivered (registered-mail tracking, envelope or acknowledgement)
documents.title: Proof of the date the notice was received

must_show: share passed on to the rent
documents.title: Landlord's breakdown of the cost increases or additional services, with the supporting invoices, interest notices or cost statements

facts.question: Does the claim state that the landlord has announced, demanded or charged a higher rent for the dwelling, by a notice, a letter, an invoice or otherwise (whether or not on an official form)?
Does the claim state that the increase is a step fixed in advance in the lease, by which the rent rises periodically by fixed amounts (graduated rent)?
Does the claim state that the increase applies a clause of the lease linking the rent to an index (such as the Swiss consumer price index)?

Does the increase notice give, as its reason, higher costs for the landlord (for example higher mortgage interest or operating costs) or additional services or works by the landlord (for example a renovation)?
Does the claim state that, together with the rent increase, the landlord gave notice of termination?
